title: perf(local): parallel view processing and frequent part cleanup on ingest

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge Only two bench-harness defects are real; the engine-level behaviour is pinned by a read-back test, but the in-memory wiring in `server.ts` has none. 2 notes · tests partial −1 · risk medium Adds an ingest benchmark harness and two chDB tunings: `parallel_view_processing` on the connection and 1 s / 4-thread part cleanup in every generated config, plus a backups-free config for `--in-memory`. The production path is sound and safe to merge; the defects are in the new bench script. - `Chdb.open` sets `parallel_view_processing = 1` on every connection - Every generated chDB config now carries MergeTree part-cleanup settings - `--in-memory` writes its own config via `writeIngestConfig`, without `` - New `bench:ingest` and `bench:ingest:chdb` harnesses, now typechecked ### Findings
🔵 Note · F1 · settings restores an A/B setting with an unquoted value correctness · [`apps/cli/bench/ingest-chdb.ts:137`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/67d9954d68d1195fb78f57360f22388a8e49192c/apps/cli/bench/ingest-chdb.ts#L137) `system.settings.value` comes back as ClickHouse prints it, so restoring a string-valued setting emits `SET session_timezone = UTC` (or `SET join_algorithm = direct,hash`), which is a syntax error: the A/B run dies after measuring and no report is written. Quote the value, which ClickHouse accepts for numeric settings too. ``` db.exec(`SET ${name} = '${current}'`) ```
🔵 Note · F2 · A failed bench:ingest:chdb run leaves its scratch store behind correctness · [`apps/cli/bench/ingest-chdb.ts:264-265`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/67d9954d68d1195fb78f57360f22388a8e49192c/apps/cli/bench/ingest-chdb.ts#L264-L265) `db.close()` and `rmSync(root)` sit after every measurement, so any throw inside `stages`/`settings`/`views`/`sustained` skips both and leaves a `maple-bench-chdb-*` store (full local schema) in `$TMPDIR` — one per failed retry while tuning. Wrap the measured sections in `try`/`finally` around `db.close()` and `rmSync`.
### Production impact
Production traffic of the changed files (last 7 days) | File | Calls/day | Busiest operations | | --- | ---: | --- | | `apps/cli/bench/payloads.ts` | 4.8k | `GET /health` 2.7k/day, 0.0% err
`GET` 995/day, 1.4% err
`GET` 627/day, 12.5% err | | `apps/cli/bench/ingest-http.ts` | 2.6k | `POST` 1.3k/day, 4.0% err
`POST` 1.2k/day, 0.2% err |
What was checked - `resolveChdbConfigFile`'s `backups` flag only picks which file is generated; a supplied `--chdb-config-file` is still returned untouched (`server.ts:697`) - The in-memory store root is a per-run `mkdtemp` removed on scope close, so the new config file dies with it (`in-memory-store.ts:163`) - No local schema view uses `POPULATE`, so the bench's `DROP VIEW`/re-create round trip in `views()` loses no target rows

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge Only the bench script changed at this head and both earlier findings are gone; config change is pinned by a real-chDB read-back test. no findings · tests covered · risk medium The follow-up commit fixes both bench findings: `bench:ingest:chdb` quotes and escapes setting values on apply and restore, and wraps the whole run in try/finally that closes the connection and deletes its scratch store. Clean to merge. - `setSetting` quotes/escapes values for both `--settings` variants and restores - `main` closes chDB and removes the scratch dir in `finally` ### Fixed since the last review - ✅ ~~F1 · `settings` restores an A/B setting with an unquoted value~~ - ✅ ~~F2 · A failed `bench:ingest:chdb` run leaves its scratch store behind~~ ### Production impact
Production traffic of the changed files (last 7 days) | File | Calls/day | Busiest operations | | --- | ---: | --- | | `apps/cli/bench/payloads.ts` | 4.8k | `GET /health` 2.7k/day, 0.0% err
`GET` 995/day, 1.4% err
`GET` 629/day, 12.4% err | | `apps/cli/bench/ingest-http.ts` | 2.6k | `POST` 1.3k/day, 4.0% err
`POST` 1.2k/day, 0.2% err |
What was checked - Setting restore reads the live value from `system.settings` and re-applies it quoted (`ingest-chdb.ts:138-141`) - Committed report shows all sections ran: 28 views enumerated, A/B settings and 900 sustained exports (`docs/benchmarks/local-ingest-chdb-2026-10-28-after.json`) - `db?.close()` exists on `Chdb` and the scratch `root` is removed after it (`ingest-chdb.ts:247-250`)
